say:0:1534433001:1.text: The ground is strewn with freshly picked mushrooms, and villagers are busy sorting them. You hear these are best when fresh... want to try one?
say:0:1534433001:1.source_cn: 地上铺满了刚摘下来的蘑菇，人们正在忙碌地分拣。听说这种...

choice_prompt:1:1534433001.text: The ground is strewn with freshly picked mushrooms, and villagers are busy sorting them. You hear these are best when fresh... want to try one?
choice_prompt:1:1534433001.source_cn: 地上铺满了刚摘下来的蘑菇，人们正在忙碌地分拣。听说这种新鲜的蘑菇最好吃了……怎么样，要不要拿一个尝尝？

narration:2:1534433002:0.text: Without a second thought, you pop one into your mouth.
narration:2:1534433002:0.source_cn: 你以迅雷不及掩耳之势，将离你最近的蘑菇塞进了嘴里……
narration:2:1534433002:0.male: Without a second thought, you pop one into your mouth.
narration:2:1534433002:0.female: Without a second thought, you pop one into your mouth.

narration:3:1534433003:0.text: A delicate sweetness blooms on your tongue—followed immediately by a wave of dizziness. Everything goes black.
narration:3:1534433003:0.source_cn: 奇异的清甜在你的口腔蔓延，随之而来的是一阵晕眩……半晌...
narration:3:1534433003:0.male: A delicate sweetness blooms on your tongue—followed immediately by a wave of dizziness. Everything goes black.
narration:3:1534433003:0.female: A delicate sweetness blooms on your tongue—followed immediately by a wave of dizziness. Everything goes black.

say:7:1534433004:0.text: You see a glorious treasure chest! You sprint toward it, thrilled—when suddenly—
say:7:1534433004:0.source_cn: 宝箱！就在你满心欢喜地奔向它时，忽然——

say:8:1534433005:0.text: Splash! Ice-cold stream water swallows you whole.
say:8:1534433005:0.source_cn: 扑通！冰冷的溪水瞬间淹没了你……

say:9:1534433006:0.source_cn: 有人掉在水里了，快来救人啊！

say:10:1534433007:0.text: Hey! Wake up! Are you okay?
say:10:1534433007:0.male: Hey! Wake up! Are you okay?
say:10:1534433007:0.female: Hey! Wake up! Are you okay?

choice_prompt:12:1534433007.text: Hey! Wake up! Are you okay?
choice_prompt:12:1534433007.male: Hey! Wake up! Are you okay?
choice_prompt:12:1534433007.female: Hey! Wake up! Are you okay?

say:14:1534433008:0.text: Did you eat a mushroom? That was a petal umbrella! We set those aside to discard. They cause powerful hallucinations.
say:14:1534433008:0.source_cn: 你是不是吃了放在这里的蘑菇？那是我们分拣出来要丢掉的弥...
say:14:1534433008:0.male: Did you eat a mushroom? That was a petal umbrella! We set those aside to discard. They cause powerful hallucinations.
say:14:1534433008:0.female: Did you eat a mushroom? That was a petal umbrella! We set those aside to discard. They cause powerful hallucinations.

say:15:1534433009:0.text: Please, be more careful next time. Don't just sample the forage!
say:15:1534433009:0.source_cn: 哎，下次小心点，别吃这种有问题的蘑菇了！
say:15:1534433009:0.male: Please, be more careful next time. Don't just sample the forage!
say:15:1534433009:0.female: Please, be more careful next time. Don't just sample the forage!
